facts.fact: UNCTAD's 2024 e-commerce readiness assessment says Mauritania 's'est récemment doté d'un Agenda National de Transformation Numérique 2022-2025'; no adopting act, body or date is named, and the report's year, 2024, is used as the date.

UNCTAD says the 2022-2025 agenda, focused mainly on infrastructure and digital administration, provides three projects to boost e-commerce and digital platforms, among them a reliable physical addressing system that depends on mobilising technical and financial partners; it states no cost; the report's year, 2024, is used as the date.
